_Last updated on December 15, 2025_

### 1. Introduction

These applications are called the ONEST Job Reference Applications. They are accessible via the following:

- **ONEST Job Provider Reference App:** Karnataka — https://postjob.onest.network and UP — https://up-postjob.onest.network
- **ONEST Job Seeker Reference App:** Karnataka — https://getjob.onest.network and UP — https://up-getjob.onest.network

(together, the "ONEST **Reference Apps**"). The ONEST Reference Apps have been developed as open-source software by EkStep Foundation ("**EkStep**"). EkStep is a not-for-profit company incorporated under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013, with its registered office at No. 85, 7th Cross, Koramangala 4th Block, Bangalore 560034, Karnataka, India.

The ONEST Reference Apps are designed to make job opportunities more discoverable and to enable hyperlocal connections between those looking to hire and those seeking work. They enable users to post vacancies, share information about job opportunities, and manage recruitment processes. They also allow users to discover available openings, apply for jobs, and exchange related information.

The ONEST Reference Apps are currently being used for a pilot programme managed by EkStep to improve job matching and transparency for local hiring. During this pilot, information provided by you will be stored securely and used exclusively for operating and improving the ONEST Reference Apps.

After the pilot concludes, the ONEST Reference Apps may be transitioned to a suitable organisation — such as a government body or other third party institution — to enable continued scale and impact. Your information will only be transferred to such an entity with your explicit consent, which will be separately requested at that time.

By accessing or using the ONEST Reference Apps, you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms of Use ("**Terms**"), our Privacy Policy, and any other policies or guidelines we may publish from time to time, as amended. The terms "**you**" and "**your**" refer to any person who accesses, views, or uses the ONEST Reference Apps. The terms "**we**", "**us**", and "**our**" refer to EkStep.

Set out below are the Terms of Use of the ONEST Reference Apps:

### 2. Definitions

For the purposes of these Terms:

1. "**User**" refers to any individual who accesses or uses the ONEST Reference Apps, whether or not they create an account. This includes both "Job Providers" and "Job Seekers".
2. "**Job Provider**" refers to a User who uses the ONEST Reference Apps to post job opportunities, manage recruitment activities, and review or respond to applications. A Job Provider may act: (i) in their individual capacity; or (ii) on behalf of an "Organisation", in which case the Organisation shall be deemed responsible for all actions taken on its behalf.
3. "**Job Seeker**" refers to a User who uses the ONEST Reference Apps to search for, view, or apply for job opportunities. Job Seekers may create a profile, upload documents, and submit applications through the ONEST Reference Apps. A Job Seeker may act: (i) in their individual capacity; or (ii) on behalf of an "Organisation", in which case the Organisation shall be deemed responsible for all actions taken on its behalf.
4. "**Organisation**" refers to any entity, whether registered or unregistered, including companies, NGOs, government agencies, partnerships, or trusts, that is represented on the ONEST Reference Apps by a Job Provider or Job Seeker.
5. "**Content**" means any material, including without limitation text, documents, presentations, scripts, graphics, images, illustrations, photographs, sounds, music, videos, audiovisual combinations, or other forms of expression, that may be viewed on, accessed through, or made available via the ONEST Reference Apps.
6. "**User Information**" means any Content or data submitted, uploaded, or otherwise made available to the ONEST Reference Apps by a User, whether as part of account registration, creating or updating a profile, posting a job, or applying for a job. User Information includes, without limitation:
   - **For Job Providers:** (i) organisational details such as name, type, location, registration or identification numbers, logo, description, and contact details of authorised representatives; (ii) job-related details such as job title, description, number of openings, role requirements, remuneration and benefits, and selection criteria; and (iii) any supporting materials or media uploaded in connection with the foregoing.
   - **For Job Seekers:** (i) personal details such as name, contact information, demographic information, and any verified documents or identifiers imported via DigiLocker or similar services; (ii) professional details such as educational qualifications, skills, work experience, and salary expectations; (iii) work preferences such as job type, location, and working hours; and (iv) any supporting materials or media uploaded in connection with the foregoing, including resumes, certificates, or portfolios.

   For further details on the categories of User Information collected and their purposes, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

### 3. Access and Use

1. As a User, you represent and warrant that you are of legal age and are legally competent to form a binding contract (or if not, you've received your parent's or guardian's permission to use the ONEST Reference Apps and they have agreed to these Terms on your behalf). Minors (below eighteen years of age) may browse or view publicly available Content on the ONEST Reference Apps with the consent and supervision of a parent or legal guardian, but may only create or manage an account or profile with such parent's or guardian's active participation and consent.
2. If you are creating an account or using the ONEST Reference Apps on behalf of an Organisation, you represent and warrant that you are duly authorised to act on its behalf and to bind it to these Terms.
3. All users may access and browse job opportunities and related content available on the Reference Apps without creating an account. However, if you wish to post jobs or apply to job opportunities, you will need to create an account on the ONEST Reference Apps.
4. Users may create an account on the Reference Apps in one of two ways:
   - Directly through the web application — by visiting the links provided at the start of these Terms and entering the required information; or
   - Through an AI-powered voice bot — which collects the required information through a guided conversation to help you create your account or profile on the ONEST Reference Apps.
5. Please note, the AI-powered voice bot registration flow is intended only for adult users (18 years or older). Minors or persons creating profiles on behalf of minors, must complete the registration process directly through the web application, where parental or guardian consent can be properly captured and verified. We do not knowingly collect information from minors, and any such data, if inadvertently received, may be deleted in accordance with the Privacy Policy.
6. In both modes of registration, before an account or profile is created, you will have the opportunity to review, update, and confirm that all information shown on the Reference Apps is complete and accurate. By confirming and proceeding, you represent that the information provided (whether directly or through the bot) is true and correct to the best of your knowledge. You agree to keep such information updated at all times.
7. You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality and security of your account credentials, and for all activities carried out through your account. You must promptly notify us of any unauthorised use or suspected breach of security.
8. Your access and use of the ONEST Reference Apps may occasionally be disrupted due to technical or operational difficulties, and such downtime may occur without prior notice. We do not guarantee uninterrupted access or availability of the Reference Apps.
9. Access to and use of the ONEST Reference Apps is subject to these Terms.

### 4. Privacy Policy

We take the privacy of Users seriously. Please review our full Privacy Policy, which forms part of these Terms. By using the ONEST Reference Apps and/or providing your information, you consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your information in accordance with the Privacy Policy and any other applicable policies or guidelines published by us from time to time.

All Users must comply with applicable laws while using the ONEST Reference Apps. You agree not to misuse the Reference Apps or access them through any means other than those expressly permitted under these Terms. You are solely responsible for any content you provide and for your interactions with other Users, and you must treat all Users with respect, fairness, and in compliance with applicable law.

Without limiting the generality of the above, you shall not:

1. Use the ONEST Reference Apps for any purpose other than for the purposes set out in these Terms;
2. post, upload, or distribute any defamatory, libelous, or inaccurate Content or other content on the Reference Apps;
3. post, upload, or distribute any Content or other content that is unlawful or that a reasonable person could deem to be objectionable, offensive, indecent, pornographic, harassing, threatening, vulgar, hateful, racially or ethnically offensive, or otherwise inappropriate;

10. use the Reference Apps for any illegal purpose, or in violation of any local, state, national, or international law, including, without limitation, laws governing intellectual property and other proprietary rights, and data protection and privacy;
11. defame, harass, abuse, threaten or defraud Users, or collect, or attempt to collect, personal information about Users or third parties without their consent;
12. remove, circumvent, disable, damage or otherwise interfere with security-related features of the ONEST Reference Apps;
13. modify, adapt, translate or create derivative works based upon Content on the Reference Apps or any part thereof, except and only to the extent expressly permitted by the license applicable to such Content, if any;
14. intentionally interfere with or damage operation of the ONEST Reference Apps or any User's usage of it, by any means, including without limitation by participation in any denial-of-service type attacks or by uploading or otherwise disseminating viruses, adware, spyware, worms, or other malicious code; or
15. Deploy bots, scrapers, or automated tools (including AI-based tools) to extract, generate, or manipulate Content in a misleading, deceptive, or harmful way.

### 6. Additional Responsibilities of Job Providers

If you are a Job Provider, you agree to:

1. ensure that all User Information you submit, including Organisation details, job listings, and supporting documents, is accurate, lawful, up to date, and not misleading;
2. Refrain from posting User Information that is unlawful, fraudulent, exploitative, discriminatory, or otherwise harmful;
3. ensure that all recruitment activity conducted through the Reference Apps complies with applicable laws, regulations, and guidelines, including without limitation labour, anti-discrimination, employment, and data protection laws;
4. refrain from any form of discrimination based on caste, religion, race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other status protected under Indian law;
5. keep any User Information of Job Seekers received through the ONEST Reference Apps confidential and use it solely for legitimate recruitment purposes;
6. have, maintain, and make available to Job Seekers a clear and accessible privacy policy describing how you handle their User Information, including the purposes of processing, retention periods, and rights under applicable law; and
7. take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect User Information of Job Seekers from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, or misuse, in compliance with applicable laws, including the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

### 7. Additional Responsibilities of Job Seekers

If you are a Job Seeker, you agree to:

1. ensure that all User Information you submit, including your profile, application materials, and supporting documents, is accurate, complete, and kept up to date;
2. share documents or information only as necessary for job applications and related communication; and
3. use the Reference Apps responsibly and in compliance with applicable laws, including those relating to data protection and privacy.

By applying to a job opportunity through the ONEST Reference Apps, you expressly consent to your User Information being shared with the relevant Job Provider. You acknowledge and agree that such User Information will then be handled by the Job Provider in accordance with their own privacy practices and policies, and that EkStep is not responsible for the Job Provider's use, disclosure, or safeguarding of such information once it has been shared.

### 8. Content and Intellectual Property

1. **User Content:** You are solely responsible for all Content you submit, upload, or share through the Reference Apps. By doing so, you:
   - represent and warrant that you have all necessary rights, licenses, and permissions to use and share such Content; and

You may not copy, reproduce, modify, distribute, display, or otherwise use any EkStep content, branding, or materials without our prior written consent, unless expressly permitted by a licence.    Use of the ONEST Reference Apps does not grant you any ownership or licence in EkStep's intellectual property, except as expressly set out in these Terms.

These Terms (including any policies, terms and guidelines) may be updated or modified from time to time and the revised Terms will be reflected herein. Your continued use of the ONEST Reference Apps constitutes acceptance of the then-current Terms. Hence, we encourage you to visit this page periodically to review any changes.

## उपयोग की शर्तें

_अंतिम अद्यतन: 15 दिसंबर, 2025_

### 1. परिचय (Introduction)

ये एप्लिकेशन ONEST जॉब रेफरेंस एप्लिकेशन कहलाती हैं। इन्हें निम्नलिखित लिंक से एक्सेस किया जा सकता है:

- ONEST Job Provider Reference App UP: https://up-postjob.onest.network
- ONEST Job Seeker Reference App UP: https://up-getjob.onest.network

(साथ में, "ONEST रेफरेंस एप्स")।

ONEST रेफरेंस एप्स को EkStep Foundation ("EkStep") द्वारा ओपन-सोर्स सॉफ़्टवेयर के रूप में विकसित किया गया है। EkStep एक गैर-लाभकारी कंपनी है, जो भारतीय कंपनियों अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 8 के तहत पंजीकृत है, और जिसका पंजीकृत कार्यालय No. 85, 7th Cross, Koramangala 4th Block, Bangalore 560034, Karnataka, India में स्थित है।

ONEST रेफरेंस एप्स का उद्देश्य रोजगार के अवसरों की खोज को आसान बनाना और हाइपरलोकल कनेक्शन सक्षम करना है, ताकि नौकरी देने वाले और नौकरी खोजने वाले सीधे और सुरक्षित रूप से जुड़ सकें। एप्स उपयोगकर्ताओं को वैकेंसी पोस्ट करने, नौकरी अवसरों की जानकारी साझा करने और भर्ती प्रक्रियाओं का प्रबंधन करने की सुविधा प्रदान करते हैं।

वर्तमान में, ONEST रेफरेंस एप्स EkStep द्वारा प्रबंधित पायलट प्रोग्राम में उपयोग किए जा रहे हैं। इस दौरान, आपके द्वारा प्रदान की गई जानकारी सुरक्षित रूप से संग्रहीत की जाएगी और केवल एप्स के संचालन और सुधार के लिए उपयोग की जाएगी।

पायलट समाप्त होने के बाद, ONEST रेफरेंस एप्स को किसी उपयुक्त संगठन (जैसे सरकारी निकाय या अन्य तीसरे पक्ष की संस्था) को हस्तांतरित किया जा सकता है। आपकी जानकारी केवल आपकी स्पष्ट सहमति से ही ऐसे संगठन को हस्तांतरित की जाएगी।

ONEST रेफरेंस एप्स का उपयोग करके, आप इन उपयोग की शर्तों ("शर्तें"), हमारी गोपनीयता नीति और समय-समय पर प्रकाशित अन्य नीतियों और दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार बाध्य होने के लिए सहमत होते हैं।

### 2. परिभाषाएँ (Definitions)

- **उपयोगकर्ता (User)**: कोई भी व्यक्ति जो ONEST रेफरेंस एप्स का उपयोग करता है, चाहे उसने खाता बनाया हो या नहीं। इसमें Job Providers और Job Seekers शामिल हैं।
- **Job Provider**: वह उपयोगकर्ता जो नौकरी पोस्ट करने, भर्ती प्रबंधन, और आवेदन समीक्षा/प्रतिक्रिया के लिए एप्स का उपयोग करता है। यह व्यक्तिगत रूप से या किसी संगठन की ओर से कार्य कर सकता है।
- **Job Seeker**: वह उपयोगकर्ता जो नौकरी खोजने, देखने या आवेदन करने के लिए एप्स का उपयोग करता है। व्यक्तिगत रूप से या किसी संगठन की ओर से कार्य कर सकता है।
- **संगठन (Organisation)**: कोई भी इकाई, पंजीकृत या अपंजीकृत, जिसमें कंपनियां, NGO, सरकारी एजेंसियां, साझेदारी या ट्रस्ट शामिल हैं।
- **सामग्री (Content)**: टेक्स्ट, दस्तावेज़, प्रस्तुतियाँ, स्क्रिप्ट, ग्राफ़िक्स, छवियाँ, फोटो, ध्वनि, संगीत, वीडियो, ऑडियो-विज़ुअल संयोजन आदि।
- **उपयोगकर्ता जानकारी (User Information)**: कोई भी डेटा या सामग्री जो उपयोगकर्ता द्वारा एप्स पर प्रदान, अपलोड या उपलब्ध कराई गई हो।

### 3. प्रवेश और उपयोग (Access and Use)

- आप कानूनी उम्र के हैं या माता-पिता/अभिभावक की अनुमति के साथ उपयोग कर रहे हैं।
- नाबालिग (18 वर्ष से कम) केवल माता-पिता/अभिभावक की सक्रिय सहमति और पर्यवेक्षण में खाता या प्रोफ़ाइल बना सकते हैं।
- संगठन की ओर से खाता बनाने वाले उपयोगकर्ता पुष्टि करते हैं कि उन्हें संगठन की ओर से कार्रवाई करने और इसे इन शर्तों से बाध्य करने का अधिकार है।
- खाता बनाना आवश्यक है यदि आप नौकरी पोस्ट या आवेदन करना चाहते हैं।
- खाता बनाने के दो तरीके हैं: वेब एप्लिकेशन या AI-आधारित वॉइस बॉट (केवल 18 वर्ष या उससे अधिक)।
- खाता/प्रोफ़ाइल बनाने से पहले, उपयोगकर्ता सभी जानकारी की समीक्षा और पुष्टि करेंगे।
- खाता क्रेडेंशियल्स की सुरक्षा उपयोगकर्ता की जिम्मेदारी है। किसी भी अनधिकृत उपयोग की तुरंत रिपोर्ट करना आवश्यक है।

### 7. Job Seeker ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಗಳು (Additional Responsibilities of Job Seekers)

### 9. ನಿಯಮಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ (Changes to Terms)

### 10. ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆಯ ಮಿತಿಗಳು (Limitation of Liability)

### 12. ವಾರಂಟಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಅಸ್ವೀಕರಣ (Warranty and Liability Disclaimer)

_Last updated: 20 August 2026_

### 1. About This Platform

**BLUE DOTS** (the "Platform") is operated by **JOINT FACILITATION CENTRE, GHAZIABAD** (referred to in these Terms as "we", "us", or "our"). The Platform is accessible at:

- **Seeker app:** https://gzb-seekers.bluedotseconomy.org/
- **Provider app:** https://gzb-providers.bluedotseconomy.org/ · https://gzb-services.bluedotseconomy.org/
- **Aggregator app:** https://gzb-aggregators.bluedotseconomy.org/

The Platform connects people who are looking for opportunities, services, or support with individuals and organisations that offer them. It enables users to create profiles, list offerings, discover relevant matches, and make connections. The Platform facilitates discovery and connection only — it does not facilitate financial transactions and is not a marketplace.

The Platform is part of a pilot programme designed to test, learn, and generate knowledge that can be used to deploy these solutions at scale.

By accessing or using the Platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use ("**Terms**") and our Privacy Notice. The Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data and forms part of these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Platform.

### 2. Definitions

The following terms have the meanings set out below wherever they appear in these Terms.

| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| **"Account"** | The relationship between a User and the Platform, created upon successful registration, which enables login, Profile creation, and use of Platform features. |
| **"Aggregator"** | An organisation that uses the Aggregator app to onboard, manage, and represent groups of Seekers or Providers on the Platform. Aggregators act on behalf of the participants they onboard and are responsible for ensuring those participants have given informed consent before their Personal Data is submitted to the Platform. |
| **"Connection"** | An interaction between a Seeker and a Provider, or between two Providers, initiated by one party and accepted by the other, following which Personal Data is exchanged between them with their consent. A Connection may take different forms — such as applying, enrolling, selecting, shortlisting, offering, or requesting opportunities, services, or support. |
| **"Network Facilitator"** | JOINT FACILITATION CENTRE, GHAZIABAD, the entity that operates and governs the Platform. |
| **"Organisation"** | Any entity, whether registered or unregistered, including companies, government bodies, NGOs, partnerships, or trusts, using the Platform through an authorised representative. |
| **"Personal Data"** | Any data about an individual who is identifiable by or in relation to such data, as defined under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023. |
| **"Platform"** | As defined in Section 1 of these Terms. |
| **"Profile"** | The information a User creates and maintains on the Platform, which may include Personal Data and non-personal information such as how they describe themselves, their needs, their offerings, or their services. |
| **"Provider"** | A User who creates an Account on the Platform to list and offer opportunities, services, or support of any kind to Seekers. A Provider may be an individual or an Organisation. |
| **"Seeker"** | A User who creates an Account on the Platform to discover and connect with opportunities, services, or support. A Seeker may be an individual or an Organisation. |
| **"User"** | Any individual or Organisation that accesses or uses the Platform, whether or not they have created an Account. Includes Seekers, Providers, and Aggregators. |

### 3. Who Can Use the Platform

**3.1 Age.** You must be 18 years of age or older to create an Account or Profile. If you are below 18, you may only use the Platform with the active involvement and consent of a parent or legal guardian, who must register and manage the Account on your behalf.

**3.2 Persons with disability with lawful guardian.** Where a person with disability who, despite adequate support, is unable to take legally binding decisions has a lawful guardian under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016 or any other law, that guardian may register and manage an Account on their behalf.

**3.3 Organisational Users.** If you are using the Platform on behalf of an Organisation, you represent and warrant that you are authorised to act on its behalf and to bind it to these Terms.

**3.4 Aggregators.** If you are registering as an Aggregator, you represent and warrant that you are acting on behalf of an Organisation with the legal capacity to enter into agreements and onboard participants on their behalf, that you are authorised to do so, and that you will not submit any participant's Personal Data to the Platform without that participant's prior informed consent. Aggregator registrations are subject to approval by the Network Facilitator.

**3.4A Aggregator coordinators.** An Aggregator may designate individuals within their Organisation or network to act on its behalf on the Platform as coordinators. A coordinator is a person authorised by the Aggregator to log in, upload participant data, and manage participant profiles on the Aggregator's behalf. If you are registering as a coordinator linked to an Aggregator, your registration is subject to approval by the Aggregator you are linked to. By approving your registration, the Aggregator accepts responsibility for all actions you take on the Platform, including any Personal Data you submit on their behalf.

**3.5 How to create an Account.** You may browse publicly available content on the Platform without creating an Account. To create a Profile, initiate or accept Connections, or use the Aggregator dashboard, you must register. Your Account may be created in the following ways:

- **3.5.1 Through the app or a QR code:** visit the relevant URL or scan a QR code shared by an Aggregator or the Network Facilitator. You will be asked to enter your contact details and year of birth, read and accept these Terms, and consent to the processing of your Personal Data before an OTP is sent to verify your contact details. Your Account will be activated once OTP verification is complete.
- **3.5.2 Through the AI voice bot:** you may initiate a call through numbers shared by us, or be contacted on our behalf. An AI-powered voice assistant will guide you through registration over a phone call. The voice bot will identify itself as an AI-powered voice assistant at the start of the call, explain what Personal Data it will collect and why, tell you how you can delete your Profile, and ask for your verbal confirmation before any data is collected. Your Account will be created in a pending state and activated once you confirm your Profile on the app. Voice bot registration is not available for minors — if you are below 18 or are registering on behalf of a minor, you must use the app.
- **3.5.3 Through an Aggregator:** an Aggregator may create a pending Profile on your behalf using information you have provided to them. You will receive a message inviting you to log in and complete your registration. A pending Profile does not constitute an active Account and you are not bound by these Terms until you activate your Account through the app or a voice call. On activation, you will be asked to review your Profile, read and accept these Terms, and consent to the processing of your Personal Data as described in our Privacy Notice before your Account becomes active.

In all cases, before your Account is activated you will have the opportunity to review and correct any information in your Profile. You can also update your Profile at any time after activation from your Account settings. By confirming your Profile, you represent that the information you have provided is true and correct to the best of your knowledge.

**3.6 Your Account.** You are responsible for keeping your Account credentials secure and for all activity carried out through your Account. If you suspect any unauthorised access, please notify us immediately through the grievance process in Section 11.

### 4. Connections and Visibility

**4.1 How you appear on the Platform.** Profiles appear as dots on a discovery map. A dot signals what is being sought or provided — not who is seeking or providing. No Personal Data is visible at the dot level. What others see when they hover over your dot depends on whether you are a Seeker or a Provider and is described in our Privacy Notice.

You can search and filter by type of opportunity or service, by location, and by organisation name. Filters are designed to match what you are looking for with what is available — they do not enable you to search for or exclude other Users based on who they are.

**4.2 What others can see.**

- **4.2.1 Seekers:** your skills, needs, preferences, and general location are visible to Providers. Your Personal Data is not visible to anyone before you accept a Connection.
- **4.2.2 Providers:** your Organisation name and information about your offerings — such as type of opportunity or service, coverage area, and availability — are visible to Users on the Platform. Your Personal Data is shared only when you accept a Connection request.
- **4.2.3 Aggregators:** Aggregators can see the Profiles of participants they have onboarded. They cannot see Profiles onboarded by other Aggregators and are not visible to Seekers or Providers on the map or in search results.

For full details of what is visible at each stage, see the Privacy Notice.

**4.3 How Connections work.** A Connection is initiated when one party sends a request to another — a Seeker to a Provider, a Provider to a Seeker, or a Provider to another Provider. Before sending a request you will be shown what Personal Data will be shared if the request is accepted and asked to confirm your consent.

When you receive a Connection request and choose to accept it, you will be asked to confirm that your own Personal Data will be shared with the requesting party before the Connection is completed. A Connection will not be completed without active confirmation from both parties.

Once both parties have confirmed, Personal Data is exchanged so you can make direct contact. This exchange cannot be reversed. You may cancel a request at any time before it is accepted.

**4.4 Connections involving minors.** If your Account is registered and managed by a parent or legal guardian, a guardian OTP verification step is required when making or accepting a Connection. Your guardian will receive a one-time password to confirm the action on your behalf before any Connection is completed or Personal Data is shared.

**4.5 Notifications.** When activity occurs on your Account — such as a new Connection request, an accepted request, or a profile update — you will receive a notification by SMS, WhatsApp, or in-app message. Notifications will tell you that something has happened but will not include Personal Data such as the name or contact details of the other party. You will be directed to log in to the Platform to view the full details. If a notification needs to include Personal Data for a specific purpose, your separate consent will be sought before it is sent.

### 5. Managing Your Profile and Account

You can edit, pause, or delete your Profile, and update or delete your Account at any time. For full details of each option and what it means for your data, see the Profile and Account Management section below.

Personal Data you have already shared through accepted Connections remains with the other party and is not affected by Profile deletion or Account closure.

### 6. Privacy and Your Personal Data

We take your privacy seriously. Our Privacy Notice explains what Personal Data we collect, why we collect it, who can see it, how long we keep it, and what your rights are — including how to withdraw your consent. The Privacy Notice forms part of these Terms. Please read it before using the Platform.

By using the Platform and providing your information, you agree to the collection, use, and disclosure of your Personal Data in accordance with the Privacy Notice.

### 7. Your Responsibilities

**7.1 What applies to all Users.** All Users must comply with applicable laws while using the Platform. You agree not to misuse the Platform or access it through any means other than those expressly permitted under these Terms. You are solely responsible for any content you provide and for your interactions with other Users, and you must treat all Users with respect, fairness, and in compliance with applicable law. We reserve the right to remove any inaccurate, misleading, or unlawful content from the Platform without prior notice. By registering on the Platform you acknowledge that you have read and agree to comply with the prohibited content rules set out in Section 7.2.

**7.2 What you must not do.** Without limiting the above, you must not:

- use the Platform for any purpose other than the purposes set out in these Terms;
- post, upload, or distribute any defamatory, libellous, inaccurate, or misleading content;
- post, upload, or distribute any content that is unlawful or that a reasonable person could deem to be objectionable, offensive, indecent, pornographic, harassing, threatening, vulgar, hateful, racially or ethnically offensive, or that promotes or glorifies self-harm, suicide, or violence;
- post, upload, or distribute any content that infringes upon any third party rights including intellectual property rights, any other legal rights of any individual or organisation, or applicable law;
- post, upload, or distribute any content that threatens the security, unity, integrity, or sovereignty of India, or that is likely to incite violence or disturb public order;
- use the Platform in any manner that is harmful to minors, or in any manner that violates these Terms, the Privacy Notice, or any other policies published by the Network Facilitator;
- impersonate any person or Organisation, falsely claim an affiliation, or access the Accounts of others without permission;
- misrepresent your qualifications, experience, identity, or eligibility for any opportunity or service on the Platform;
- make unsolicited offers, advertisements, proposals, or send junk mail or spam to other Users;
- solicit the login credentials of any other User;
- defame, harass, abuse, threaten, or defraud Users, or collect or attempt to collect Personal Data about other Users or third parties without their consent;
- remove, circumvent, disable, damage, or otherwise interfere with security-related features of the Platform;
- intentionally interfere with or damage the operation of the Platform or any User's usage of it, including by uploading or disseminating viruses, adware, spyware, worms, or other malicious code;
- deploy bots, scrapers, or automated tools (including AI-based tools) to extract, generate, or manipulate content in a misleading, deceptive, or harmful way;
- submit, upload, or share any synthetically generated information — including deepfakes, AI-generated or AI-altered images, or cloned audio — that misrepresents a real person or event or that could mislead other Users about your identity or qualifications;
- communicate false or misleading information about the origin of a communication, or impersonate the Platform or any official communication channel.

**7.3 Additional responsibilities of Seekers.**

- ensure that all supporting documents you submit are accurate and current;
- not misrepresent your qualifications, experience, skills, or eligibility for any opportunity or service;
- share documents or information only as necessary for the purpose of making or accepting a Connection;
- respond to Connections in good faith — if you are no longer available or interested, update your Profile or delete your Account;
- not discriminate against any Provider based on caste, religion, race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or any other status protected under applicable law; and
- use contact details received through a Connection only for the purpose for which the Connection was made.

When you initiate or accept a Connection, you consent to your name, phone number, and email address being shared with the other party. You acknowledge that such Personal Data will then be handled by that party in accordance with their own privacy practices, and that the Network Facilitator is not responsible for how they use or safeguard your Personal Data once it has been shared.

**7.4 Additional responsibilities of Providers.** If you are a Provider, you agree to:

- ensure that all information you submit — including your Organisation details, listings, offerings, and supporting documents — is accurate, up to date, and not misleading. Remove or update any listing that is no longer available, expired, or no longer accurately describes what you offer;
- ensure that all opportunities, services, and support you list on the Platform are genuine, lawfully offered, and compliant with applicable laws including labour, consumer protection, anti-discrimination, disability, and sector-specific regulations;
- respond to Connection requests within a reasonable time. If you are unable to accept a request, decline it promptly so the other party can pursue other opportunities;
- where your offering has eligibility requirements — including age, qualification, location, or document requirements — state these clearly in your listing before a Connection is initiated;
- refrain from discriminating against any User based on caste, religion, race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other status protected under applicable law, including the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016. Connections must be based on the relevance of your offering to the other party's needs and qualifications — not on personal characteristics;
- keep all Personal Data received through the Platform — including contact details shared through a Connection — confidential and use it solely for the purpose for which the Connection was made. Do not share it with any third party without the other party's prior consent;
- refrain from using Personal Data received through the Platform for any purpose beyond the specific Connection — including marketing, profiling, or any automated decision-making — without the other party's explicit consent;
- take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect Personal Data received through the Platform from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, or misuse, in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and the rules framed thereunder. Where you are an Organisation, this includes having a documented data protection policy; and
- if you become aware of any misuse of Personal Data received through the Platform or any interaction that may have caused harm to another User, report it through the grievance process in Section 11.

**7.5 Additional responsibilities of Aggregators.** If you are an Aggregator, you agree to:

- **Obtain consent before upload.** Before submitting any participant's Personal Data to the Platform, you must have obtained that participant's informed consent. By submitting Personal Data, you represent and warrant that you hold valid consent from each participant whose data you are uploading, that this consent covers the purposes for which the Platform will use that data, and that you are authorised by the Network Facilitator to onboard participants on this Platform.
- **Maintain consent records.** You must maintain records of the consent obtained from each participant and make these available to the Network Facilitator on request. Consent records must be kept for as long as the participant's Profile remains active and for a reasonable period thereafter.
- **Ensure accuracy.** You are responsible for the accuracy of all Profiles and Personal Data you submit on behalf of participants. Update Profiles promptly when a participant's circumstances change and remove Profiles that are no longer accurate or relevant.
- **Act within your authority.** Only submit Personal Data for participants who have authorised you to act on their behalf. Do not submit data for any person without their knowledge and prior informed consent.
- **Comply with data protection law.** You are a data fiduciary in respect of the participants you onboard and are fully responsible for lawful processing, data minimisation, purpose limitation, and timely deletion in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and the rules framed thereunder.
- **Act on withdrawals promptly.** If a participant withdraws consent or requests deletion, notify the Network Facilitator immediately and take steps to have their Profile deactivated or deleted without delay. Where Personal Data was collected by you solely for the purpose of submitting it to this Platform, you must delete that data from your own systems on withdrawal. Where you hold Personal Data about a participant for other independent purposes under separate consent, your obligations in relation to that data are governed by the terms of that consent and applicable law.
- **Manage exits properly.** On ceasing to act as an Aggregator for any participant, notify the Network Facilitator and ensure the participant is informed of any changes to how their Profile will be managed. ### Profile and Account Management

_Last updated: 20 August 2026 · Version 1.0_

This section explains your options for managing your Profile and Account. We may update it as our processes evolve.

**Your options at a glance**

| Action | What it does | How to do it |
|---|---|---|
| Edit Profile | Update your information | Profile edit in navigation menu |
| Pause Profile | Hide your Profile temporarily | Profile pause in navigation menu |
| Delete Profile | Remove your Profile permanently | Profile delete in navigation menu |
| Delete Account | Remove your Account permanently | Support request in account settings |

**Edit your Profile.** You can update any information in your Profile at any time by clicking edit in the Profile Menu on the screen. Changes take effect immediately and your updated Profile will be visible to others on the Platform.

**Pause your Profile.** Pausing your Profile temporarily hides it from the Platform. While paused your Profile will not appear in search results or on the discovery map. Your Account remains active and your existing Connections are not affected. You can reactivate your Profile at any time from the navigation menu.

**Delete your Profile.** Deleting your Profile permanently removes your listing and associated data from the Platform. Your Profile will no longer be visible immediately once you confirm deletion from the Profile's action menu. Deleting your Profile does not delete your Account. You can create a new Profile at any time after deletion.

**Update your Account.** To update your Account, contact support by submitting a support request form. Once you raise a request, it may take up to 30 working days for the process to complete. You will receive a confirmation on the channel used for the Account, i.e. email or phone as used for registration.

**Delete your Account.** Deleting your Account permanently removes your Profile and Account. You will not be able to log in after your Account is deleted. To re-use the Platform you will need to register again. To delete your Account, go to Account settings and submit a support request. You will receive a confirmation by SMS or email once this is complete.

**What happens to your data.** Once your deletion request is processed, your Personal Data will be deleted in accordance with the timelines set out in the Privacy Notice. Personal Data you have already shared through accepted Connections remains with the other party and is not affected by Profile or Account deletion.

versions.title: Privacy Policy — ONEST Job Reference Applications
versions.content:
Last updated on December 15, 2025
1.  **Introduction**

This Privacy Policy (“**Policy**”) explains your rights in relation to your User Information and describes how we collect, use, store, transfer, disclose, and safeguard such information when you use the ONEST Reference Apps. It also explains how relevant Job Providers may access your information when you apply for job opportunities through the ONEST Reference Apps.
  
By accessing or using the ONEST Reference Apps, and by providing your information, you consent to its collection, use, and disclosure by us and, where applicable, by the relevant Job Providers in accordance with this Policy, the Terms of Use, and the policies and guidelines of the ONEST Reference Apps as updated from time to time. Once your information is shared with a Job Provider, it will be handled in accordance with that Job Provider’s on privacy practices, for which we are not responsible.  
If you do not agree with the terms of this Policy, please do not access or use the ONEST Reference Apps.
  
This Policy shall be read in conjunction with the Terms of Use. Defined terms used but not defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed to them in the Terms of Use.
1.  **Rights of Users**
    1.  Right to fair, transparent and lawful collection of your User Information on the ONEST Reference Apps.
    2.  Right to be informed about the ways in which your User Information that is collected on the ONEST Reference Apps will be used.
    3.  Right to receive all the information you need to provide informed consent before collection of your User Information on the ONEST Reference Apps and sharing of the same with relevant Job Providers.
    4.  Right to revoke such consent. 
    5.  Right to privacy and confidentiality regarding your User Information . 
    6.  Right to proper use of your User Information by Job Providers for specified and legitimate purposes related to your use of the ONEST Reference Apps.
    7.  Right to keep your User Information accurate and up to date. 
    8.  Right to secure collection, handling and storage of your User Information . 
    9.  Right to protection from unauthorised or unlawful use of your User Information . 
    10. Right to view and access the ONEST Reference Apps’s privacy policy. 
1.  **Responsibilities of Job Providers **
    1.  To respect the privacy and data protection rights of Users.
    2.  To  ensure the security of and use of User Information (especially any personal information) shared by Job Seekers is limited solely to the uses and purposes mentioned here.
    3.  To use User Information solely for the purposes permitted under the Terms of Use and this Policy, and in compliance with applicable laws and policies , including the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and rules framed thereunder. Job Providers are responsible and liable for ensuring such compliant use, and for any loss or damage arising from failure to adhere to this obligation.
    4.  To ensure their communication (if any) with Job Seekers is explicitly limited and relevant to the purpose of their usage of the ONEST Reference Apps and meets the Appropriateness standards set out in the Terms of Use and policies of the ONEST Reference Apps.
    5.  To ensure that Content on the ONEST Reference Apps is not used for any of the Prohibited Uses set out in the Terms of Use.
1.  **What User Information is Collected on the ONEST Reference Apps?**
    1.  If you are simply browsing the ONEST Reference Apps, we collect the same basic information that most websites or platforms collect through the use of standard internet technologies, such as cookies. This may include anonymous usage information such as your country of origin, device type, language selected, pages viewed, buttons clicked, and the date and time of this activity. Such information is collected and analysed in a de-identified or aggregated manner and does not personally identify you.
    2.  We do not collect personal or sensitive personal data or information unless you voluntarily choose to provide it to us. This will happen when you register on the ONEST Reference Apps, create or update a profile, post or apply to a job opportunity, or otherwise submit your details through the ONEST Reference Apps.
    3.  For Job Providers: If you choose to register as a Job Provider, create a profile, or post a job opportunity, you may provide:
|  |  |  |  |
| :- | :- | :- | :- |
| **Sr. No.** | **Field / Data Type** | **Whether Mandatory** | **Purpose of Collection** |
| **A. Registration  Information** |  |  |  |
| 1 | Mobile number/email | Yes | To determine if an account already exists using this contact information and to initiate the registration or login process |
| 2 | Full name and Mobile Number/email  | Yes | To enable secure account creation/log in, and authentication through OTP during login and account recovery |
| 3 | OTP (One-Time Password) verification | Yes | To verify authenticity of the mobile number/email and ensure secure account setup/login |
| 4 | Consent to Terms & Privacy Policy | Yes | To document consent for account creation and lawful processing of the information shared |
| **B. Profile Information (Who I am)** |  |  |  |
| 5 | Company / Organisation Name | Yes | To display to Job Seekers for employer identification |
| 6 | Organisation Type | No | To provide context about the nature of the employer (e.g., MSME, Startup, Enterprise) |
| 7 | Logo | No | To help Job Seekers recognise and differentiate Job Providers  |
| 8 | Location (State / City / Map) | Yes | To display jobs as “blue dots” on a map, to allow for discovery and hyperlocal hiring |
| **C. Job Posting Details (What I have)** |  |  |  |
| 9 | Job Title | Yes | To describe available roles to Job Seekers |
| 10 | Number of Openings | Yes | To indicate the number of positions available |
| 11 | Name and designation of hiring manager  | No | To provide a point of contact for the relevant job opening  |
| 12 | Job details (designation, description, responsibilities, work timings, work mode, shifts, benefits,, other role-specific details — non-exhaustive) | No | To provide sufficient information for Job Seekers to evaluate if the role  suits them |
| 13 | salary details | Yes | To provide sufficient information for Job Seekers to evaluate if the role  suits them |
| 14 | Optional Uploads (photos, videos, documents) | No | To provide additional information about the Job Provider and the job opportunity |
| **D. Application Requirements (What I want)** |  |  |  |
| 15 | Selection Criteria (e.g., age range, educational qualifications, work experience, skills, languages — non-exhaustive) | No | To specify minimum requirements and preferences for Job Seeker applications |

1.  **For Job Seekers**: If you choose to register as a Job Seeker, create or update a profile(s), or apply to a job opportunity, you may provide:
|  |  |  |  |
| :- | :- | :- | :- |
| **Sr. No.** | **Field / Data Type** | **Mandatory** | **Purpose of Collection** |
| **A. Registration Information** |  |  |  |
| 1 | Mobile number/email | Yes  | To determine if an account already exists using this contact information and to initiate the registration or login process |
| 2 | Year of birth | Yes | To determine if the User is an adult (18 years or older) or a minor (below 18 years) for consent and compliance purposes  |
| 3 | Full name and mobile number/email of parent/guardian (if User is a minor) | Yes | To obtain verifiable consent from a parent or guardian for the minor’s use of the ONEST Reference Apps |
| 4 | Full name and Mobile Number/email (for all other Users) | Yes | To enable secure account creation/log in, and authentication through OTP during login and account recovery |
| 5 | OTP (One-Time Password) Verification | Yes | To verify the authenticity of the registered contact number or email and ensure secure access |
| 6 | Consent to Terms & Privacy Policy | Yes | To document consent for account creation and lawful processing of the information shared |
| **B. Profile Information (Who I am)**    Where no application is made, profile remains visible only to the Job Seeker |  |  |  |
| 7 | Full Name (auto-populated) | Yes | To identify you to Job Providers upon application |
| 8 | age | Yes | To allow Job Providers to verify age eligibility and compliance with applicable laws |
| 9 | Information imported from digital wallets (DigiLocker or others) | No | To enable auto-population of verified information for accuracy; fields imported in this manner are marked as “verified” and cannot be edited once imported |
| 10 | Location (latitude–longitude coordinates) | Yes | To display your approximate position on a map (as a blue dot) and support hyperlocal discovery by Job Providers; if you enter an address (which is not expected of you), it is converted to geolocation data (lat-long) |
| 11 | Gender (Male, Female, Other) | No | To share with Job Providers if you choose to do so |
| 12 | Phone Number (in profile, separate from registration) | Yes | To enable direct communication with you and a Job Provider in connection with your application |
| **C. Skills & Experience (What I have)** |  |  |  |
| 13 | Educational Background, skills, Languages Known/Spoken, income details, and other application responses (non-exhaustive) | No | To inform Job Providers of your qualifications and circumstances, so they can assess suitability for job opportunities |
| 14 | Highest educational qualification & Work History | Yes | To inform Job Providers of your qualifications and circumstances, so they can assess suitability for job opportunities |
| 15 | Optional Uploads (e.g. photos, videos, certificates, documents) | No | To strengthen applications, build credibility, enable verification, and enhance discoverability |
| 16 | Educational qualifications, skill certifications, assessment scores, and institute details (via scanning credential QR codes) | No | To allow automatic import of verified credentials (such as marksheets, certificates, or skill results) into your profile for accuracy |
| **D. Job Preferences (What I want)** |  |  |  |
| 17 | Job Interests, Relocation & Travel Preferences, Work Arrangements, Salary & Benefits expectations, Availability (non-exhaustive) | No | To allow Job Providers to assess applications with the requirements of the job opportunities  |

1.  **Use of Digital Wallets: **The ONEST Reference Apps allow you to import verified information from Government authorised digital wallet services such as DigiLocker. This is entirely optional. Any data retrieved from such authorised digital wallets will be shared with the Reference Apps only with your explicit consent through the digital wallet interface. You retain the right to decline the use of such digital wallets or to limit which data fields are shared. Currently, only name, age and educational qualifications are auto-populated as verified and non-editable; additional fields may be enabled in the future, subject to your consent. While the collection and sharing of such data is subject to the[ DigiLocker Privacy Policy](https://www.digilocker.gov.in/web/about/digilocker-policy) or such other privacy policy maintained by the digital wallet service provider, once data is imported, its use and handling within the ONEST Reference Apps will be governed by this Policy, the Terms of Use, and any other guidelines made available through the ONEST Reference Apps from time to time.
2.  **Use of QR Code Scanner: **The ONEST Reference Apps include a QR code scanner that enables Job Seekers to import credential data directly into their profiles. These QR codes are generated through [*Mark Studio*](https://onest-jobs.dhiway.net/), a product of Dhiway Networks Private Limited, and made available to Users free of cost until March 2026. Use of this feature is optional. The scanner cannot read ordinary QR codes; it only processes credential QR codes created in a specific format by Mark Studio (or other approved digital attestation services). Any data retrieved via QR codes may be used to populate fields such as highest educational qualification, institute name, certifications, or skill scores. The credential data is verified and attested by an ecosystem partner which could include Job Seeker Organisation or a third party. The use of Mark Studio is governed by the [Mark Studio Privacy Policy](https://studio.dhiway.com/page/privacy-policy). Once imported, the use and handling of the data within the ONEST Reference Apps will be governed by this Policy, the Terms of Use, and any other guidelines made available through the Reference Apps from time to time.
  
**Note**: EkStep does not independently verify credential data and is not responsible for its accuracy.
1.  **Children as Registered Users: **
    1.  Children under 18 years of age are neither required to nor encouraged to provide their personal information directly.
    2.  The ONEST Reference Apps collect a User’s year of birth to determine whether they are below 18 years of age. Where a User is identified as a minor (under 18 years), the ONEST Reference Apps require the full name and mobile number or email address of a parent or legal guardian. A one-time password (OTP) is then sent to that mobile number or email address to obtain verifiable consent before the account is created. The account will be set up only upon successful verification, and the parent or guardian will be responsible for reviewing, managing, and supervising the child’s use of the ONEST Reference Apps.
    3.  Children under 18 years are not permitted to create accounts or share personal information through the AI-powered voice bot, which is intended solely for use by adults. If any personal information belonging to a minor is inadvertently collected by the AI-powered bot or through any other unintended means, we will delete such information on a best-efforts basis as soon as it is identified.
    4.  We encourage parents and guardians to review, update, or request deletion of their ward’s information at any time through the app interface or by contacting the support channels provided in this Policy.
1.  **User Representations: **You represent that the information you provide on the ONEST Reference Apps is accurate, current, and complete, and that you have all necessary rights, permissions, and consents to provide such information. By providing such information, and by its subsequent collection, storage, usage, transfer, access, or processing in accordance with this Policy and the Terms of Use, you confirm that no third-party rights, contracts, laws, or court orders are violated.
1.  **Who has access to User information?**
    1.  The information you provide will be stored and guarded by EkStep Foundation; Email: <info@ekstep.org>. We are not responsible for any personal information or sensitive personal data or information collected by other platforms, websites, third-party services, or external links or content linked on the ONEST Reference Apps. Such third parties or content creators are bound by the respective data protection laws applicable to them and should have their own terms of use and privacy policy documents.
    2.  We will not publish or disclose your information without your prior consent, unless: (i) required by law; (ii) you have consented to disclosure; or  
         (iii) disclosure is necessary to provide services to you.
    3.  We will share your User Information as follows:
        1.  With Job Providers: When a Job Seeker applies to a role, their User Information is shared with that Job Provider. Passwords or account authentication credentials are not shared with Job Providers. 
        2.  With Job Seekers: When Job Providers post job opportunities, relevant User Information is made available to all Users of the Reference Apps. Passwords or account authentication credentials are not shared with Users. 
        3.  With our service providers and partners: For hosting, analytics, verification, communications, and other support services, with appropriate confidentiality and security safeguards.
        4.  For legal purposes: If required by applicable law, regulation, or legal process, or to protect the rights, property, and safety of EkStep, Users, or others.
        5.  Business or organisational transfers: If EkStep undergoes restructuring, merger, or transfer of functions, User information may form part of the transferred assets.
    4.  Your information is only accessible outside of the ONEST Reference Apps when it is necessary to offer the service, comply with law, or with your permission.
1.  **What is User Information Used For? **
    1.  We process your information only when necessary and for lawful purposes connected with the operation of the ONEST Reference Apps. In addition to the purposes listed in the tables above, the broad uses include:
        1.  **Account creation and profile management**: to register you on the ONEST Reference Apps, create and update your profile, and provide a personalised experience.
        2.  **Verification and compliance**: to validate the authenticity of accounts created and to comply with applicable laws and regulations.
        3.  **Recruitment and job applications**: to enable Job Providers to post and manage job opportunities, and Job Seekers to apply for job opportunities, including facilitating communication between Job Providers and Job Seekers.
        4.  **Discoverability and hyperlocal hiring**: 
            1.  For Job Providers: the job opportunity you post may be displayed as a blue dot on a map, visible to Job Seekers through the ONEST Reference Apps. 
            2.  For Job Seekers: your location data may be used to display your profile as a blue dot on a map, visible only to the relevant Job Provider who has posted a job you apply for, through the ONEST Reference Apps. If you create a profile without applying to any job, your location will only be visible to you and not to others.   
                This feature enables hyperlocal hiring and helps connect Job Providers and Job Seekers in the same locality.
        5.  **ONEST Reference Apps functionality and improvement**: to operate, maintain, and improve the features, content discovery, search, and recommendation functions of the ONEST Reference Apps.
        6.  **Security and fraud prevention**: to detect and prevent misuse, fraudulent activity, multiple accounts, or activity that violates the Terms of Use or applicable law.
        7.  **Communication and support**: to contact you with important information relating to your account, job applications, or the operation of the ONEST Reference Apps, and to respond to feedback, complaints, or support queries.
        8.  **Research and reporting**: to generate de-identified and aggregated reports and analytics about the usage of the ONEST Reference Apps, in order to improve offerings over time.
        9.  **Other lawful purposes**: for any other use that is disclosed to you at the time of collection, or otherwise permitted by applicable law.
    2.  We may engage third-party service providers (e.g., for hosting, analytics, communications, technical support) to facilitate or outsource certain operations of the ONEST Reference Apps. These service providers are bound by confidentiality and data protection obligations and may use your information only for the specific purpose for which it is provided. 
    3.  If we wish to use your information for a new purpose not covered by this Policy, we will provide you with a notice before such processing, and where required, seek your consent.
    4.  In any event, your information will not be used for the following purposes:
        1.  Sale, rental, or other commercial exploitation of your information;
        2.  Advertising or marketing unrelated to the ONEST Reference Apps;
        3.  Unsolicited phone calls, messages, or other communications not connected to recruitment or your use of the ONEST Reference Apps;
        4.  Building a personal profile for non-recruitment purposes;
        5.  Any prohibited purposes set out in the Terms of Use; or
        6.  Any purpose not disclosed in this Policy or otherwise permitted by law.
    5.  Job Provider Use of User Information: Job Providers are independently responsible for any User Information they access through the ONEST Reference Apps. They must use such information only for recruitment purposes, and in compliance with applicable laws (including labour and data protection laws). Misuse or unauthorised use by Job Providers is a violation of the Terms of Use and may result in suspension, termination, or legal action. 
    6.  By using the ONEST Reference Apps, you acknowledge and agree that the collection, storage, and processing of your information is for lawful purposes connected with the operation of the ONEST Reference Apps and provision of services, and that such information is necessary for enabling your participation in recruitment-related activities on the ONEST Reference Apps.
 
1.  **How is User Information stored? **
    1.  We adopt reasonable and appropriate security practices and procedures in accordance with Indian laws currently in force, including the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011. These measures include administrative, physical, and technical safeguards to protect your personal information. 
    2.  Your User Information, including personal information and any sensitive personal data or information, is securely stored primarily in electronic form on Google cloud Platform (GCP) with servers located in India. Certain data may also be stored in physical form where necessary.
    3.  We engage third-party service providers to store and process data. These providers are contractually bound to implement industry-standard security measures and to use your data only for the purposes specified by us.
    4.  We employ a combination of measures, including network and infrastructure security, encryption, access controls, and manual procedures, to protect your information against loss, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.
    5.  While we strive to protect your User Information, no system or method of transmission over the Internet is completely secure. Accordingly, we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information during transmission to the ONEST Reference Apps. Once received, however, we implement reasonable procedures and security features to prevent unauthorized access, consistent with applicable Indian law.
    6.  If you believe your User Information has been compromised or accessed without authorization, please contact us immediately at <info@ekstep.org>.
 
1.  **How long is User Information stored?**
    1.  Your information will not be retained for a period more than necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Policy, unless a longer retention period is required by law or for directly related legitimate purposes.
    2.  When information is no longer required, we will either delete it securely or anonymise it so that it no longer identifies you.
    3.  **Pilot Data Retention and Transfer**
        1.  Your User Information will be retained on our servers for the duration of the ONEST pilot managed by us. Once the pilot concludes, an organisation — such as a government body, institution, or trusted third party — may scale or continue this initiative.
        2.  In such an event, your User Information will only be transferred to that organisation with your **explicit consent**, which will be requested and captured directly through the ONEST Reference Apps or via other secure communication channels.
        3.  If you choose not to provide such consent, your User Information will not be transferred and will instead be securely deleted in accordance with our data retention practices.  
2.  **How can you request Deletion of your information? **
    1.  If you wish to delete your User Information, you may initiate this process directly through the interface of the ONEST Reference Apps. Once you request deletion, you will be shown a summary of the User Information stored against your account. You must confirm your intent to delete this information to proceed.
    2.  Upon confirmation, your User Information will be permanently deleted within 30 days. You will receive an email confirmation once the deletion is complete. Please note that deleting your information will result in cancellation of your account and may disable your access to certain features of the ONEST Reference Apps.
    3.  You agree and acknowledge that certain data or information cannot be deleted or may be prohibited to be deleted as required under any applicable law, law enforcement requests or under any judicial proceedings.
1.  **What are the system permissions required by the Reference Apps?**
    1.  Camera: Your system Camera will only be used if you want to scan QR codes to import your information into the ONEST Reference Apps.
    2.  Access to Files and Documents: To allow you to upload résumés, certificates, or other Content when creating your profile or applying for jobs. 
    3.  Device Storage (download functionality): To enable you to download job-related information, application confirmations, or other Content from the ONEST Reference Apps.
1.  ** Cookies: How are they used? What types of cookies are used? How to manage your cookies? **
    1.  We may use cookies and similar technologies to:
        1.  Improve User experience.
        2.  Analyse traffic and usage patterns.
        3.  Remember preferences and settings.

## डिजिटल वॉलेट का उपयोग (Use of Digital Wallets)
ONEST Reference Apps आपको सरकारी अधिकृत डिजिटल वॉलेट सेवाओं जैसे DigiLocker से सत्यापित जानकारी आयात करने की अनुमति देते हैं। यह पूर्णतः वैकल्पिक है। ऐसे अधिकृत डिजिटल वॉलेट से प्राप्त कोई भी डेटा केवल डिजिटल वॉलेट इंटरफ़ेस के माध्यम से आपकी स्पष्ट सहमति से ही Reference Apps के साथ साझा किया जाएगा। आप ऐसे डिजिटल वॉलेट के उपयोग को अस्वीकृत करने या साझा किए जाने वाले डेटा फ़ील्ड को सीमित करने का अधिकार रखते हैं। वर्तमान में, केवल नाम, आयु और शैक्षणिक योग्यताएँ स्वतः “verified” और non-editable के रूप में भरी जाती हैं; भविष्य में अतिरिक्त फ़ील्ड आपके सहमति के अधीन सक्षम की जा सकती हैं।  
 हालाँकि ऐसे डेटा का संग्रह और साझाकरण DigiLocker की अपनी गोपनीयता नीति (या डिजिटल वॉलेट सेवा प्रदाता द्वारा बनाए गए किसी अन्य गोपनीयता नीति) के अधीन होगा, एक बार डेटा आयात हो जाने के बाद, उसका उपयोग और संचालन ONEST Reference Apps के भीतर इस नीति, Terms of Use तथा समय–समय पर उपलब्ध अन्य दिशानिर्देशों द्वारा नियंत्रित होगा।
## QR Code Scanner का उपयोग
ONEST Reference Apps में एक QR code scanner शामिल है जो Job Seekers को अपने प्रोफ़ाइल में क्रेडेंशियल डेटा सीधे आयात करने में सक्षम बनाता है। ये QR codes Mark Studio, जो Dhiway Networks Private Limited का उत्पाद है, के माध्यम से उत्पन्न किए जाते हैं और Users को मार्च 2026 तक निःशुल्क उपलब्ध कराए जाते हैं। इस सुविधा का उपयोग वैकल्पिक है। यह scanner साधारण QR codes नहीं पढ़ सकता; यह केवल उस विशेष प्रारूप में बनाए गए credential QR codes को प्रोसेस करता है जो Mark Studio (या अन्य अनुमोदित digital attestation services) द्वारा निर्मित होते हैं।  
 QR codes के माध्यम से प्राप्त कोई भी डेटा उच्चतम शैक्षणिक योग्यता, संस्थान का नाम, प्रमाणपत्र या कौशल स्कोर जैसे फ़ील्ड्स को भरने के लिए उपयोग किया जा सकता है। यह credential डेटा किसी ecosystem partner द्वारा verified और attested किया जाता है, जिसमें Job Seeker Organisation या कोई तीसरा पक्ष शामिल हो सकता है। Mark Studio का उपयोग Mark Studio Privacy Policy द्वारा नियंत्रित होता है। एक बार आयात हो जाने पर, इस डेटा का उपयोग और संचालन Reference Apps के भीतर इस नीति, Terms of Use तथा समय–समय पर उपलब्ध अन्य दिशानिर्देशों द्वारा नियंत्रित होगा।
नोट: EkStep credential डेटा को स्वतंत्र रूप से सत्यापित नहीं करता है और उसकी सटीकता के लिए उत्तरदायी नहीं है।
## Children as Registered Users (पंजीकृत उपयोगकर्ता के रूप में बच्चे)
18 वर्ष से कम आयु के बच्चों को अपनी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी सीधे प्रदान करने के लिए न तो बाध्य किया जाता है और न ही इसके लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाता है।
ONEST Reference Apps उपयोगकर्ता के **जन्म वर्ष** को एकत्र करते हैं, ताकि यह निर्धारित किया जा सके कि वह 18 वर्ष से कम आयु का है या नहीं। जहाँ किसी उपयोगकर्ता की पहचान **नाबालिग (18 वर्ष से कम आयु)** के रूप में होती है, वहाँ ONEST Reference Apps माता-पिता या कानूनी अभिभावक का पूरा नाम तथा मोबाइल नंबर अथवा ईमेल पता अनिवार्य रूप से मांगते हैं। इसके पश्चात, उस मोबाइल नंबर या ईमेल पते पर एक **One-Time Password (OTP)** भेजा जाता है, ताकि खाता बनाने से पूर्व सत्यापन योग्य सहमति प्राप्त की जा सके। सफल सत्यापन के पश्चात ही खाता सक्रिय किया जाएगा, तथा माता-पिता/अभिभावक बच्चे द्वारा ONEST Reference Apps के उपयोग की समीक्षा, प्रबंधन और पर्यवेक्षण के लिए उत्तरदायी होंगे।
18 वर्ष से कम आयु के बच्चों को AI-संचालित voice bot के माध्यम से खाते बनाने या किसी भी प्रकार की व्यक्तिगत जानकारी साझा करने की अनुमति नहीं है, क्योंकि यह सुविधा केवल वयस्कों के उपयोग हेतु अभिप्रेत है। यदि किसी नाबालिग से संबंधित कोई व्यक्तिगत जानकारी AI-संचालित bot द्वारा या किसी अन्य अनपेक्षित माध्यम से अनजाने में एकत्र हो जाती है, तो हम ऐसी जानकारी की पहचान होते ही उसे **best-efforts basis** पर यथाशीघ्र हटाने का प्रयास करेंगे।
हम माता-पिता और अभिभावकों को प्रोत्साहित करते हैं कि वे किसी भी समय अपने बच्चे/वार्ड की जानकारी की समीक्षा करें, उसे अपडेट करें, या उसे हटाने का अनुरोध करें, यह सब ऐप इंटरफ़ेस के माध्यम से या इस नीति के अंतर्गत प्रदान किए गए सहायता चैनलों से संपर्क करके किया जा सकता है।

## How is User Information stored? (User Information कैसे संग्रहीत की जाती है?)
हम भारत में वर्तमान में लागू कानूनों के अनुरूप, जिसमें **Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011** शामिल हैं, उचित और उपयुक्त सुरक्षा प्रथाओं और प्रक्रियाओं को अपनाते हैं। इन उपायों में प्रशासनिक, भौतिक (physical) तथा तकनीकी सुरक्षा उपाय शामिल हैं, ताकि आपकी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी की सुरक्षा की जा सके।
आपकी User Information, जिसमें व्यक्तिगत जानकारी एवं कोई भी संवेदनशील व्यक्तिगत डेटा/जानकारी शामिल है, मुख्यतः इलेक्ट्रॉनिक स्वरूप में **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** पर भारत में स्थित सर्वरों पर सुरक्षित रूप से संग्रहीत की जाती है। कुछ डेटा आवश्यकता पड़ने पर भौतिक स्वरूप में भी संग्रहीत किया जा सकता है।
हम डेटा को संग्रहीत और संसाधित करने हेतु तीसरे पक्ष के सेवा प्रदाताओं को नियोजित करते हैं। ऐसे प्रदाताओं पर उद्योग-मानक सुरक्षा उपाय लागू करने और आपके डेटा का उपयोग केवल हमारे द्वारा निर्दिष्ट उद्देश्यों हेतु करने का अनुबंधात्मक दायित्व होता है।
हम नेटवर्क और इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर सुरक्षा, एन्क्रिप्शन, एक्सेस कंट्रोल और मैनुअल प्रक्रियाओं सहित विभिन्न उपायों का प्रयोग करते हैं, ताकि आपकी जानकारी को खोने, दुरुपयोग, अनधिकृत पहुँच, प्रकटीकरण, परिवर्तन या विनाश से संरक्षित किया जा सके।
हालाँकि हम आपकी User Information की सुरक्षा हेतु प्रयासरत हैं, फिर भी इंटरनेट पर कोई भी प्रणाली या डेटा संप्रेषण विधि पूर्णतः सुरक्षित नहीं है। अतः ONEST Reference Apps तक जानकारी भेजते समय हम पूर्ण सुरक्षा की गारंटी नहीं दे सकते। एक बार जानकारी प्राप्त होने के पश्चात, हम लागू भारतीय कानूनों के अनुरूप उचित प्रक्रियाएँ और सुरक्षा विशेषताएँ अपनाते हैं।  
 यदि आपको संदेह हो कि आपकी User Information से समझौता किया गया है या अनधिकृत पहुँच प्राप्त हुई है, तो कृपया तुरंत **info@ekstep.org** पर संपर्क करें।
## How long is User Information stored? (User Information कितने समय तक संग्रहीत की जाती है?)

## Pilot Data Retention and Transfer (पायलट डेटा का भंडारण और स्थानांतरण)

ऐसी स्थिति में, आपकी User Information को केवल आपकी **स्पष्ट सहमति** के पश्चात ही उस संगठन को स्थानांतरित किया जाएगा, जिसे सीधे ONEST Reference Apps या अन्य सुरक्षित संचार माध्यमों के माध्यम से अनुरोधित और दर्ज किया जाएगा।

ಈ ಗೌಪ್ಯತಾ ನೀತಿ (“ನೀತಿ”) ನೀವು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಳಕೆದಾರ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ನೀವು ONEST Reference Apps ಅನ್ನು ಬಳಸುವಾಗ ನಾವು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಬಳಸುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿಡುತ್ತೇವೆ, ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ ಮತ್ತು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನೀವು ONEST Reference Apps ಮೂಲಕ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದಾಗ ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಾತರು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನೂ ಇದು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
ONEST Reference Apps ಅನ್ನು ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸುವ ಅಥವಾ ಬಳಸುವ ಮೂಲಕ, ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಮೂಲಕ, ನೀವು ಈ ನೀತಿ, ಬಳಕೆ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯದಿಂದ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ನವೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗುವ ONEST Reference Apps ನ ನೀತಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರ್ಗಸೂಚಿಗಳ ಅನುಸಾರವಾಗಿ ನಮ್ಮಿಂದ ಹಾಗೂ, ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿದಲ್ಲಿ, ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಾತರಿಂದ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಲು, ಬಳಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸಲು ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತೀರಿ. ಒಮ್ಮೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಾತರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಂಡ ನಂತರ, ಅದು ಆ ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಾತರ ಸ್ವಂತ ಗೌಪ್ಯತಾ ಆಚರಣೆಗಳ ಅನುಸಾರವಾಗಿ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ಅವಕ್ಕೆ ನಾವು ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರರಾಗಿರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

## ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಾತರ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಗಳು
ಬಳಕೆದಾರರ ಗೌಪ್ಯತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಡೇಟಾ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನು ಗೌರವಿಸುವುದು.  
 ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಹುಡುಕುವವರು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಂಡ ಬಳಕೆದಾರ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ (ವಿಶೇಷವಾಗಿ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ) ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆಯನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಅದನ್ನು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖಿತ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಕಟ್ಟುನಿಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಸೀಮಿತಗೊಳಿಸುವುದು.  
 ಬಳಕೆ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಈ ನೀತಿಯ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಮತಿಸಿದ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಳಕೆದಾರ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಅನ್ವಯವಾಗುವ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾನೂನುಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ನೀತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಅನುಗುಣವಾಗಿ ನಡೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು, ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ (ಯುಕ್ತವಾದ ಭದ್ರತಾ ಆಚರಣೆಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂವೇದನಶೀಲ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮಾಹಿತಿ) ನಿಯಮಗಳು, 2011 ಮತ್ತು ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಪರ್ಸನಲ್ ಡೇಟಾ ಪ್ರೊಟೆಕ್ಷನ್ ಆಕ್ಟ್, 2023 ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರೂಪಿಸಿದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಸೇರಿವೆ. ಈ ರೀತಿಯ ಅನುಗುಣತೆಯನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸುವ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಾತರದ್ದೇ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಈ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯದ ಉಲ್ಲಂಘನೆಯಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಯಾವುದೇ ನಷ್ಟ ಅಥವಾ ಹಾನಿಗೆ ಅವರು ಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರರಾಗಿರುತ್ತಾರೆ.  
 ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಹುಡುಕುವವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ನಡೆಸುವ ಯಾವುದೇ ಸಂವಹನವನ್ನು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ONEST Reference Apps ಬಳಕೆಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸೀಮಿತಗೊಳಿಸುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಬಳಕೆ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ONEST Reference Apps ನ ನೀತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಿದ ಸೂಕ್ತತಾ ಮಾನದಂಡಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸುವಂತೆ ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು.
